transcript_only_text:
Don't  expect  to  be  accepted  if  you  want 
 to  be  exceptional.  Because  to  be 
 exceptional,  by  definition,  you  have  to 
 be  the  exception,  which  means  no  one 
 will  be  just  like  you.  They  won't  agree, 
 they  won't  understand,  and  the 
 willingness  to  be  disagreed  with  and 
 misunderstood  is  what  allows  you  to  not 
 be  like  everyone  else,  which  makes  you 
 the  exception  and  thereby  exceptional.
